# bloxone_cdc_application (Resource)

Manages an Application.

The Application object represents a Cloud Data Connector (CDC) application, such as a Python script, that can process flow data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bloxone_cdc_application" "example" {
  name = "example_cdc_application"

  data = {
    scripts = [{
      filename = "script_1.py"
      content  = "print(\"hello\")"
    }]
  }
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_application" "example_with_optional_fields" {
  name        = "example_cdc_application_optional_fields"
  description = "Example CDC application"
  enabled     = false

  data = {
    scripts = [{
      filename = "script_1.py"
      content  = "print(\"hello\")"
    }]
  }
  variables = {
    var1 = "value1"
  }

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_application" "example_with_script_file" {
  name = "example_cdc_application_script_file"

  data = {
    scripts = [{
      filename = "cdc_application_handler_sample.py"
      # Load the script content from a file next to this configuration
      content = file("${path.module}/cdc_application_handler_sample.py")
    }]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `data` (Attributes) The application data containing the scripts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `name` (String) The name of the application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the application is enabled.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the application.
- `variables` (Map of String) The variables for the application.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the application, including default tags.
- `type` (String) The type of the application.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
